title: Evaluation of structural and thermodynamic insight of ERbeta with DPN and derivatives through MMGBSA/MMPBSA methods.
one_liner_zh: 该文用MMGBSA/MMPBSA方法评估ERbeta与DPN配体的结合自由能，属于蛋白-小分子互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无TF-DNA结合建模，仅方法可部分借鉴。
abstract: Estrogen receptors (ERs) are nuclear factors that exist as two subtypes: ERalpha and ERbeta. Among the different selective ERbeta agonist ligands, the widely used ERbeta-selective agonist DPN (diarylpropionitrile) is highlighted. Recent experimental and thermodynamic information between R-DPN and S-DPN enantiomers with ERbeta is important for evaluating further the ability of MD simulations combined with end-point methods to reproduce experimental binding affinity and generate structural insight not provided through crystallographic data. In this research, starting from crystallographic data and experimental binding affinities, we explored the structural and thermodynamic basis of the molecular recognition of ERbeta with DPN and derivatives through triplicate MD simulations combined with end-point methods. Conformational analysis showed some regions with the highest mobility linked to ligand association that, at the time, impacted the total protein fluctuation. Binding free energy (DeltaG) analysis revealed that the Molecular Mechanics Generalized-Born Surface Area (MMGBSA) approach was able to reproduce the experimental tendency with a strong correlation (R = 0.778), whereas per-residue decomposition analysis revealed that all the systems interacted strongly with eight residues (L298, E305, L339, M340, L343, F356, H475, and L476). The comparison between theoretical studies using the MMGBSA approach with experimental results provides new insights for drug designing of new DPN derivatives.
abstract_zh: 雌激素受体（ERs）是核因子，存在两种亚型：ERalpha 和 ERbeta。在多种选择性 ERbeta 激动剂配体中，广泛使用的 ERbeta 选择性激动剂 DPN（二芳基丙腈）尤为突出。近期关于 R-DPN 和 S-DPN 对映体与 ERbeta 之间的实验和热力学信息，对于进一步评估分子动力学（MD）模拟结合终点方法再现实验结合亲和力并生成晶体学数据未提供的结构见解的能力至关重要。在本研究中，从晶体学数据和实验结合亲和力出发，我们通过三次重复的 MD 模拟结合终点方法，探索了 ERbeta 与 DPN 及其衍生物分子识别的结构和热力学基础。构象分析显示，某些与配体结合相关的高流动性区域同时影响了整体蛋白质的波动。结合自由能（DeltaG）分析表明，分子力学广义玻恩表面积（MMGBSA）方法能够以强相关性（R = 0.778）再现实验趋势，而逐残基分解分析显示，所有系统均与八个残基（L298、E305、L339、M340、L343、F356、H475 和 L476）发生强烈相互作用。使用 MMGBSA 方法的理论研究与实验结果之间的比较，为新型 DPN 衍生物的药物设计提供了新见解。
